svg.title: Counting semaphore admission and binary signaling
svg.desc: Two initial permits admit at most two tasks. Separately a producer writes data and releases a binary semaphore, allowing a consumer to acquire and read.

g.text: Permits control admission; releases can also publish signals
Return one permit on scope exit
A release before a waiter arrives leaves an available permit.
Semaphores do not own resources, identify payloads, or provide automatic shutdown.
